items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: We called him S. J., another one was called H. B. He's the only one that didn't bother with the music

ctx.x: We called him S. J., another one was called H. B. He's the only one that didn't bother with the music, and another brother, Theophilus, the same Greek lady named him.
